Priority order:

Priority Order
I want to catch up on everything in the game. Please be sure to share the livestream when work is done so I can watch. Please do work using the below priority order.
1. Dailies first
Complete daily activity tasks.
Claim daily/login/event/mail rewards.
Check anything that resets or expires soon.
2. Spend Waveplates Efficiently to build any useful characters — I don’t have anyone built yet, so use your judgment,
3. Limited-time events
Complete temporary events as much as possible.
Prioritize rewards like Astrite, pull currency, upgrade materials, and event shop items.
Don’t spend premium currency during events.
4. Unlock useful content
Unlock areas, bosses, domains, teleports, or quests needed for , events, or farming.
Main story is okay only if it unlocks important content.
5. Exploration and side quests
Do chests, puzzles, map completion, side quests, and regional rewards.
Prioritize newer/important areas or anything with good rewards.
Permanent events
Only do these if dailies, Waveplates, limited events, and useful exploration are handled.

- Do not do daily tasks. I will do them myself.
- Do not do any current limited-time events. I will do them myself.
- Do not do recurring/reset events, such as Fantasies of the Thousand Gateways, Tower of Adversity, or similar events. I will do them myself.

Please do:
